headline: CRML SOARS 7% AS TANBREEZ DRILLS TURN — CRITICAL METALS LAUNCHES 10,000m CAMPAIGN AT GREENLAND'S WORLD-CLASS HEAVY REE DEPOSIT
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Critical Metals Corp. (Nasdaq: CRML)
snippet: Critical Metals Corp. (Nasdaq: CRML) announced June 17, 2026 the commencement of its planned 10,000-metre diamond drilling campaign at Tanbreez in Southern Greenland — the world's largest heavy rare earth deposit — sending shares up 7% on the day in a year when CRML has already gained 158%. Drill rigs, contractors, and support teams mobilized successfully to site; infrastructure including accommodation and operational facilities is now commissioned to support both the 2026 drilling campaign and the ongoing $30 million acceleration plan targeting first ore by Q4 2028. Tanbreez carries 92.5% ownership following Greenland government approval of the transfer of the final 50.5% stake in April 2026, and houses exceptional concentrations of terbium and dysprosium — the heavy rare earth elements at the center of China's January 2026 strategic reclassification and export control regime. For rare earth equity investors, a 10,000-metre program commencing at a globally significant HREE deposit under 92.5% Western control — on the same day China's HRE export quota allocations remain tightly rationed — represents the supply-chain visibility event that US defense and industrial buyers tracking Project Vault's $12 billion critical mineral stockpile framework have been waiting for.

headline: G2 SHAREHOLDERS 80.6% YES — G MINING ACQUIRES OKO-GHANIE AS G3 GOLDFIELDS SPINS OUT IN 72% PREMIUM GUYANA GOLD CONSOLIDATION
snippet: G2 Goldfields Inc. (TSX: GTWO) shareholders voted 80.61% in favour of the plan of arrangement with G Mining Ventures Corp. (TSX: GMIN) on June 16, 2026, approving G Mining's acquisition of all G2 shares at 0.212 GMIN shares plus 0.5 shares of newly listed G3 Goldfields per G2 share held — implying a 72% premium to G2's pre-announcement price. Deal close is expected in early July 2026. G Mining gains the Oko-Ghanie Gold Project in Guyana's Puruni District, which it will combine with its adjacent Oko West concession to create what both companies describe as a Tier-1 Guyana gold district with over $1 billion in synergies and an accelerated permitting timeline. G3 Goldfields — the spin-out vehicle retaining G2's exploration-stage Guyana ground — is expected to commence trading shortly after closing, giving G2 shareholders a unit exposure to both a near-production senior and a grassroots explorer simultaneously. For TSXV/TSX gold M&A investors, the 80.6% approval at a 72% premium continues the pattern of senior producers consolidating advanced Guyana and Latin American gold systems at significant premiums while the gold price sits at $4,347 — 36% below institutional year-end targets.

headline: 972 g/t GOLD IN CORE — CONTANGO SILVER & GOLD POSTS BONANZA AT LUCKY SHOT AS PHASE 1 OF 18,000m ALASKA UNDERGROUND WRAPS
source_name: Investing News Network / Contango Silver & Gold Inc. (NYSE: CTGO)
snippet: Contango Silver & Gold Inc. (NYSE: CTGO) released June 16, 2026 final assay results from Phase 1 of its 18,000-metre underground and surface exploration program at the Lucky Shot Gold Project in Southcentral Alaska — highlighted by hole LSU26091 intersecting the L1d Vein at 0.17 metres grading 972.10 g/t gold with visible gold observed in core. Phase 1 comprised 65 HQ diamond drill holes totalling approximately 6,020 metres and tested the L1c, CK, L2, and additional veins across the known Lucky Shot underground workings. Contango has now restarted underground exploration development with contractor GMS Mine Repair & Maintenance, which has advanced 43 metres toward a planned 800-metre excavation campaign over approximately five months. At gold above $4,300, a 972 g/t bonanza vein confirmed in Phase 1 and an active Phase 2 underground development program at a fully permitted past-producing Alaska gold project — in a jurisdiction where permitting timelines are measured in months rather than years — establishes Lucky Shot as one of the most advanced high-grade underground gold development stories on the NYSE American.

headline: GRANDE PORTAGE DRILLS AT NEW AMALGA — 4,300m DEVELOPMENT PROGRAM STARTS 25km FROM JUNEAU AS ALASKA GOLD PROJECT CROSSES INTO PERMITTING PHASE
source_name: Finanzwire / Grande Portage Resources Ltd. (TSXV: GPG)
snippet: Grande Portage Resources Ltd. (TSXV: GPG) commenced its 2026 drilling program at the New Amalga Gold Project near Juneau, Alaska on June 17, 2026, launching up to 4,300 metres of diamond drilling across up to 14 drillholes. The program marks a shift in program design from pure resource expansion toward development-stage objectives: holes are specifically designed to upgrade resource classification and characterize geotechnical and hydrogeological parameters required for the environmental review and US Forest Service permitting process. Timberline Drilling is the drilling contractor; Coastal Helicopters Inc. of Juneau provides helicopter logistics. New Amalga sits 25 kilometres from Alaska's capital and 6 kilometres from paved highway — infrastructure proximity that materially compresses the project's development capital relative to remote Alaska or northern BC comparators. At $4,300+ gold, a development-drill program focused on permitting-data collection at a road-accessible Juneau-area gold deposit signals that Grande Portage is advancing toward a formal development decision, not merely adding resource tonnes.

headline: MURMAC DRILLS TURN NEAR URANIUM CITY — FORTUNE BAY AND MANHATTAN URANIUM TARGET 25 ATHABASCA BASIN CONDUCTORS IN 5,000m SUMMER PUSH
source_name: Investing News Network / Fortune Bay Corp. (TSXV: FOR) + Manhattan Uranium Discovery Corp. (TSXV: MANU)
snippet: Fortune Bay Corp. (TSXV: FOR) and Manhattan Uranium Discovery Corp. (TSXV: MANU) commenced diamond drilling at the Murmac Uranium Project in northern Saskatchewan on June 16, 2026, with the summer program advancing on 15 of 25 identified priority targets and designed to test both follow-up targets near prior uranium intersections and new conductors not previously drilled. The fully funded 5,000-metre program is operated by Fortune Bay under an option agreement; Manhattan Uranium is the funding partner. Murmac sits in Saskatchewan's Athabasca Basin near Uranium City — the same geological terrain that has produced the Basin's highest-grade uranium systems from Cameco's McArthur River to IsoEnergy's Hurricane deposit. At uranium spot $86/lb and long-term contract prices at $91.50/lb — with US utilities accelerating contracting ahead of the January 2028 Russian-origin import ban and nuclear power's resurgent political support — a 25-target Athabasca Basin program near established high-grade uranium infrastructure is the category of systematic exploration that has historically preceded meaningful resource discoveries at Basin-analogous structural settings.

headline: THE IRAN DEAL CHANGED THE FED MATH — OIL AT $80.53, A SIXTH STRAIGHT SILVER DEFICIT, AND 762M OZ IN DRAWDOWNS EXPLAIN TODAY'S SILVER MOVE
snippet: GoldSilver.com's June 17 analysis unpacks the specific mechanism behind silver's sustained rally: oil falling to $80.53 per barrel (a two-month low) on the imminent Iran-US deal signing in Switzerland on June 19 directly reduces the energy component of CPI, reframing May's 4.2% headline as a potential cycle ceiling rather than a floor — which compresses real yield expectations and removes the primary near-term bearish case for non-yielding silver. With the gold-silver ratio at 61.3 (below the 50-year historical average of 65-70), silver is reclaiming relative ground against gold even as both metals rally. The Silver Institute's World Silver Survey 2026 documents a sixth consecutive annual supply deficit projected at 46.3 million ounces (wider than 2025's 40.3M oz) and a cumulative 762.1 million-ounce drawdown from above-ground stockpiles since 2021 — a physical demand reality that sits beneath any geopolitical-driven price move and prevents the recoveries from reversing fully. For retail silver investors weighing the current $70.94/oz entry point, the GoldSilver.com framework separates the short-cycle catalyst (Iran deal oil math) from the long-duration structural driver (six years of deficits, 762M oz cumulative drawdown) that has made every significant silver pullback since 2021 a loading opportunity.

headline: LITHIUM CLIMBS BACK ABOVE $25,000 AND SPODUMENE TOPS $2,000/MT FOR FIRST TIME SINCE 2023 — EV AUTOMAKERS' COST ROADMAPS FACE A RECKONING
snippet: Battery-grade lithium carbonate climbed back above $25,000 per tonne on June 17, 2026 — with spodumene prices simultaneously breaking $2,000 per metric tonne for the first time since late 2023 — putting real pressure on the EV affordability timelines automakers have been selling to investors and consumers. China lithium carbonate recovered to CNY 169,500 per tonne (+0.30% on the day), recovering from a two-month low of CNY 163,000 as seasonal inventory rebuilding drove spot bids. The dual recovery in both upstream spodumene and downstream carbonate is analytically significant because it confirms the tightening is working through the full supply chain rather than being a one-market anomaly. For TSXV and ASX lithium mining investors, the spodumene recovery above $2,000/mt directly improves the economics of restart decisions (MinRes Bald Hill is already ramping) and de-risks projects requiring $1,500-1,800/mt pricing for positive project economics — a threshold now comfortably cleared for the first time in 18 months. With Morgan Stanley projecting an 80,000-tonne LCE deficit in 2026 and energy storage demand rising 55% year-over-year, the lithium bottom is increasingly regarded as confirmed.

headline: SILVER'S BEST JUNE IN 25 YEARS — GOLDSEEK DOCUMENTS SILVER OUTPERFORMING GOLD IN EARLY SUMMER AT RATIO THAT HISTORICALLY PRECEDES MASSIVE RELATIVE MOVES
snippet: GoldSeek's mid-June analysis documents silver achieving its strongest early-June action in at least a quarter-century — its second-best June performance on modern record — with silver's outsized upside far outperforming gold in a month that is seasonally one of silver's weakest. The analysis notes that the current silver rally is not explained by the usual primary-silver-driver channels (industrial demand spike, ETF inflows matching early 2021 levels when SLV held 677.3 million ounces at $26.50/oz), suggesting something more structural is generating buying power that conventional demand models are underweighting. The gold-silver ratio's current compression trend — from above 100 at the 2020 peak through 65-70 in the last bull cycle to the current 61.3 — is identified as the key technical signal: when ratio compression accelerates as both metals trend higher, it historically marks the phase transition from a gold-led bull to a silver-led outperformance cycle, which produces the largest percentage gains for silver miners and royalties. For retail investors tracking Canadian and Australian silver equities, a ratio at 61.3 with physical deficits in year six and American silver investors described as having 'vast room to buy if silver keeps running' sets up a sustained silver equity outperformance window.

headline: ESKAY MINING CLOSES $3.5M FLOW-THROUGH — FULLY FUNDED FOR 5,000m GOLDEN TRIANGLE DIAMOND DRILL PROGRAM LAUNCHING IN JULY
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Eskay Mining Corp. (TSXV: ESK)
snippet: Eskay Mining Corp. (TSXV: ESK) closed a $3.5 million non-brokered flow-through private placement on June 17, 2026, providing full funding for the company's 2026 summer exploration program — including a planned 5,000-metre diamond drill program launching in July at its namesake Eskay Creek property in British Columbia's Golden Triangle. Eskay Mining's property surrounds and underlies the former Eskay Creek mine, which produced 3.3 million ounces of gold and 160 million ounces of silver at exceptionally high grades during its 1994-2008 operating life, ranking as one of the highest-grade gold-silver mines in history. The $3.5M flow-through structure provides Canadian investors a tax-efficient entry into a fully-funded summer Golden Triangle drill program at a project with direct geological heritage from one of North America's most prolific past-producing silver-gold mines. At gold above $4,300 and silver at $70.94, the combination of a July drill start, full program funding, and the Eskay Creek geological footprint provides a summer catalyst stream for TSXV precious metals investors building positions ahead of the September-October seasonal window.

headline: GOLD HOLDS $4,347 WHILE NASDAQ HITS ALL-TIME HIGH — BOTH RISING SIMULTANEOUSLY IS THE RAREST MONETARY SIGNAL IN MODERN MARKETS
snippet: GoldSilver.com's June 17 piece documents an analytically unusual condition: gold holding at $4,347 — near multi-month highs — on the same session that the Nasdaq Composite set a new all-time record. Under the classical risk-on/risk-off framework, gold and risk assets are inversely correlated: gold rises when equities fall, and vice versa. When both simultaneously set highs, it signals that the bid under gold is structural rather than fear-driven — central banks and sovereign funds are buying gold not to escape equity risk but to diversify reserves away from USD assets regardless of equity performance. This is precisely the dynamic the World Gold Council confirmed in Q1 2026 data showing 244 tonnes of net central bank purchases — with the National Bank of Poland (595 tonnes total, having purchased 14 tonnes in April alone) and the PBoC (2t, tenth consecutive monthly increase) the most active buyers — independent of equity market direction. For junior mining investors who interpret gold's strength exclusively through a fear lens, the June 17 simultaneous-highs session is a recalibration signal: the gold bull market's primary engine is reserve diversification and de-dollarisation, not recession hedging, which means equity market strength does not invalidate the gold thesis.
